summary: Ecopetrol S.A., via its Brazilian subsidiary, filed a Form 6-K announcing a voluntary tender offer on Brazil's B3 exchange to acquire 116,110,717 common shares of Brava Energia S.A. (BRAV3) at R$23.00/share, representing ~25% of outstanding shares, with a 20.9% premium to the 90-day VWAP. This is part of a larger transaction to gain a 51% controlling voting interest, previously announced April 23, 2026. The tender offer remains open until June 25, 2026, subject to regulatory approvals and conditions. Financing is via a bridge loan. Watch for regulatory clearance in Brazil and shareholder tenders.
